text:
elaine (support): Planning a maintenance window for Dedicated GPU pools this Sat 2025-06-14 02:00 UTC. ETA ~90m. Need statuspage entry + customer email template. Can we confirm pinning + rollback plan? @sam @raj

deploy-bot: maintenance created: id M-4321 window 2025-06-14T02:00Z -> 2025-06-14T03:30Z components: dedicated-gpu-pool, smart-router. auto-notify: false

sam (eng-oncall): I got this. Ops lead for the window. Plan: pin runtime to v3.4.2 before start, canary 10% for first 15m, full ramp if metrics OK. Rollback trigger: p50 latency > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive 5m buckets or error rate > 1%.

marta (product): Add short customer-facing line: "No customer data will be migrated or exposed. You may see short reconnects or higher latency for requests routed to Dedicated during the window."

leo (ops): Draft statuspage/update and email templates below. kept language simple. please :eyes: and ack tone.

leo (ops): ```
Statuspage component: Dedicated GPU Pools (api-redwood-dedicated)
Scheduled maintenance: 2025-06-14 02:00 UTC (90 minutes)
Impact: Brief increased latency and potential short reconnects for requests routed to Dedicated. Customers on Dedicated may observe transient 5xx errors during rollback.
Updates: We will post progress every 15 minutes and notify when complete.
```

leo (ops): ```
Email subject: Planned maintenance for Dedicated GPU pools — 2025-06-14 02:00 UTC
Email body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

We're performing scheduled maintenance on Redwood Dedicated GPU pools on 2025-06-14 from 02:00 to 03:30 UTC. During this window you may experience brief increases in latency, short reconnects, or transient 5xx errors if we need to rollback. No customer data will be migrated or exposed.

If you rely on strict latency SLOs, consider routing traffic to Hosted for the window or contact support to arrange a staggered rollout.

We'll post updates on our status page: https://status.redwood.ai

Thanks,
Redwood Support
```

maya (support): LGTM. small tweak: subject add region when applicable, e.g., "(global)" or "(EU)".

raj (eng-releases): For release notes: "Pinned runtime to v3.4.2 to apply kernel optimizations and memory leak fixes. Canary started at 10%. Rolling back to v3.4.1 if latency regressions or increased error rates observed." I'll add a short changelog bullet to the release-notes repo.

sam (eng-oncall): Confirming pin step: I'll create the pin and the canary hold job at T-15m. If canary fails, rollback to v3.4.1 and notify customers via statuspage with short note: "Rollback completed, full service restored."

ops-bot: canary-monitoring: started at 2025-06-14T02:00:00Z, target 10% traffic -> metrics stream OK

elaine (support): Thanks — can someone paste the statuspage incident body we should publish for the first 15m update? I want to prepare the auto-update snippet for customers.

sam (eng-oncall): Use this for the 02:15 update: "We have started a controlled canary for the pinned runtime. Monitoring shows elevated p95 by ~12% but within thresholds; canary continuing. Targeting a full ramp in next 30m if metrics remain stable."

marta (product): Add customer-facing note for rollback events: "We applied an earlier runtime; we observed regressions and reverted to the previous runtime to restore normal performance. Some requests routed to Dedicated may have seen brief failures during the revert. We're investigating and will post a root cause update if needed."

leo (ops): OK I'm scheduling the public statuspage updates at 02:00 (maintenance started), 02:15, 02:30, 02:45, and 03:30 (complete). I'll also enable the email broadcast if we hit rollback.

maya (support): I'll queue the email send list and prep support templates for customers who ask for migration options.

raj (eng-releases): One more: add a note in the customer email about SDK versions that might need reinitialization after reconnects (python-js).

elaine (support): Great — final ask: please react with :thumbsup: if you approve the language and schedule.

sam (eng-oncall): :thumbsup:

marta (product): :thumbsup:

leo (ops): :thumbsup:

maya (support): :thumbsup:

raj (eng-releases): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: maintenance M-4321 status: scheduled -> in-progress at 2025-06-14T02:00:00Z

ops-bot: note: if rollback triggered, statuspage update template: "We rolled back the pinned runtime due to performance regression. Services are being verified; we will update in 15 minutes."

elaine (support): Thanks team — I'll publish the first statuspage entry and queue the customer email as described.
